description: The Register's nightly stream of new primary records (vulnerability entries, recalls, rules) touching systems that act on their own, newest first. Signals never assign fault.

kind.description: Keep only one kind of record: vulnerability (a published vulnerability entry), report, disclosure, rule (a new or changed regulation), investigation or guidance. Leave out for all kinds.

limit.description: How many results to return, from 1 to 50. Default 10.

name: recent_signals
title: Recent signals
